correctness.rationale: The order-four recurrence follows by direct polynomial expansion and is unimodular. The identity expressing Lucas cubes as a polynomial in the Fibonacci-cube shift is verified on a complete recurrence basis; its 4-by-4 determinant is 15625. For p != 5 the transfer is an automorphism over Z_p. Modulo five the two underlying sequences have exact periods 20 and 4 and zero full-period cube sums; exact mod-25 Lucas residues fix the intermediate lengths. The 20-block bases have precise valuations 1 and 2 from exact mod-125 residues, and an invertible 5-adic geometric-sum operator proves all multiples of 20 without extrapolation. Standalone arithmetic verifies 320 window lengths. No unproved infinite step remains.
